### internal class SceneActors — SceneActors.cs:16
Finds the actor a sequence is for in the open scenes, for the inspector tools. In Play mode the actor holds its id, so that is asked first. Searches are remembered until the hierarchy changes, so drawing the inspector stays cheap.
